LESSON: WRITING 13.4.1 SPELLING: AFFIXES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Writing 13.4.1 Spelling: Affixes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.4.1 Spelling: Affixes, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it difficult to spell some words? 2. How can we become better at spelling?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  In purposive identify words with prefixes and suffixes and use them to create puzzles and share with peers,  In purposive groups, form words using prefixes and affixes,  Match words with their appropriate affixes (-un,-cian, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  In purposive identify words with prefixes and suffixes and use them to create puzzles and share with peers,  In purposive groups, form words using prefixes and affixes,  Match words with their appropriate affixes (-un,-cian, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.4.1 Spelling: Affixes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Self-efficacy: The learner’s ability to confidently perform tasks is developed as they show concerted attention to detail

while forming words using prefixes and affixes.

 Creativity and Imagination: The learner’s ability to create something new is improved as they generate ideas using mind

maps and come up with a list of related words.

Values:
Peace is promoted as the learner collaborates with peers to edit and display their journals.

123

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial Literacy: The learner is able to manage their finances better as they interact with the theme on money and trade to

create mind maps and crossword puzzles.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate the skill of spelling words correctly to their editing of written work in Kiswahili and other learning

areas.
